description: Figure 2 presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of the proposed method under different configurations. The study evaluates the impact of removing specific components from the full model, which are labeled as "Ours" (the complete model), "critiquing" (attribute-based item critiquing), "scoring" (generative item scoring), and "ranking" (efficient candidate ranking). The results are shown in two bar charts, with the left chart displaying the Recall@10 metric and the right chart showing the NDCG@10 metric. In the Recall@10 chart, the "Ours" model achieves the highest score, approximately 0.35, followed by "critiquing" at about 0.30, "scoring" at around 0.18, and "ranking" at approximately 0.23. In the NDCG@10 chart, the "Ours" model again performs best, with a score of about 0.21, followed by "critiquing" at roughly 0.19, "scoring" at about 0.07, and "ranking" at approximately 0.12. The results indicate that removing any component leads to a performance drop, with the removal of generative item scoring resulting in the most significant decrease, particularly for the NDCG@10 metric.
